annotations.title: Who reacted to a LinkedIn Page post

description: Who reacted to one of the brand’s LinkedIn company-Page posts, newest first: each person’s name, headline and profile link (a company that reacted is named with its Page link) and the reaction (Like, Celebrate, Love, Insightful, Support, Funny). Pass the post urn post_to_linkedin_page returned. A member LinkedIn does not describe is listed by profile id, never dropped. Read-only, free. Uses the LinkedIn connection that posts (not the comments authorization).

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in, for THIS CALL ONLY: an id or exact name from list_brands, needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

organizationId.description: the company Page; defaults to the Page shared with this profile

start.description: paging: the `nextStart` of the previous answer
